faqs.question: What can Pixode help me with?
faqs.answer: Pixode designs and builds business websites, mobile apps, custom web applications, and online stores. We also help with branding, UI/UX, CMS and theme customization, API integrations, bug fixes, technical SEO, performance, and ongoing support.

faqs.question: How much will my project cost?
faqs.answer: Use the package examples as a starting point. After discussing your goals, we’ll provide a proposal with deliverables, revision rounds, timeline, and a final price before work begins.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: Timing depends on scope and content readiness. A focused identity or landing page is a smaller engagement than a complete commerce experience. Your proposal includes a project-specific schedule.

faqs.question: Will I receive the source files?
faqs.answer: The agreed final design files and development deliverables are included in your handover. Third-party fonts, stock assets, platforms, and licenses are documented separately.

faqs.question: Can you refresh an existing brand or website?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Share what’s working, what isn’t, and where you want to go. We can refine your current direction or build an entirely new one.

faqs.question: Which platforms do you work with?
faqs.answer: We work with WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, and Squarespace, alongside custom web and mobile applications. We choose the approach based on your requirements and how you want to manage your product.

faqs.question: Can you help with an existing website or app?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can redesign interfaces, fix bugs, add features, connect APIs, and improve speed, navigation, checkout, dashboards, login systems, and usability.

faqs.question: Do you provide support after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can continue helping with maintenance, theme customization, technical SEO, performance improvements, fixes, updates, and new features. We agree on the support scope with you.
